test_duration_integer_conversion: test the duration module by converting between nanoseconds, seconds, milliseconds, and microseconds
test_duration_json_serialization: test the duration module by serializing and deserializing Duration messages to and from JSON strings
test_duration_timedelta_conversion: test the duration module by converting Duration messages to and from Python timedelta objects
test_duration_construction_from_timedelt: test constructing a protobuf Duration message from a Python timedelta value
test_duration_arithmetic_operations: test adding and subtracting Duration messages with datetime, timedelta, and Timestamp objects
